problem.title: Find the Ceiling of a Given Key in a Binary Search Tree
problem.problemStatement: Given the root of a Binary Search Tree and a key X, determine the smallest key in the tree that is greater than or equal to X.
problem.input: • The first line contains an integer N. • The next N lines describe the BST. • The last line contains X.
problem.output: • Print the ceiling value. If no such value exists, print NONE.
